narrative: A foul-paper sheet of the fifth act, half full, one line with a small cross in the left margin, the hand heavier than yesterday. The right forefinger is inked. A cloak is on the chair, not yet worn. No face. One surface.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Copied slowly and marked the line.
